=== hello, as clang writes it
	.section	__TEXT,__text,regular,pure_instructions
	.build_version macos, 14, 0	sdk_version 14, 4
	.globl	_main
	.p2align	4, 0x90
_main:
	pushq	%rbp
	movq	%rsp, %rbp
	subq	$16, %rsp
	movl	$0, -4(%rbp)
	leaq	L_.str(%rip), %rdi
	movb	$0, %al
	callq	_printf
	xorl	%eax, %eax
	addq	$16, %rsp
	popq	%rbp
	retq

	.section	__TEXT,__cstring,cstring_literals
L_.str:
	.asciz	"Hello, %s!\n"

.subsections_via_symbols
=== a switch through a jump table in the code
	.section	__TEXT,__text,regular,pure_instructions
	.globl	_classify
	.p2align	4, 0x90
_classify:
	pushq	%rbp
	movq	%rsp, %rbp
	cmpl	$3, %edi
	ja	LBB_default
	movl	%edi, %eax
	leaq	LJTI0_0(%rip), %rcx
	movslq	(%rcx,%rax,4), %rax
	addq	%rcx, %rax
	jmpq	*%rax
LBB_0:
	movl	$10, %eax
	popq	%rbp
	retq
LBB_1:
	movl	$20, %eax
	popq	%rbp
	retq
LBB_2:
	movl	$30, %eax
	popq	%rbp
	retq
LBB_default:
	movl	$-1, %eax
	popq	%rbp
	retq
	.p2align	2, 0x90
	.data_region jt32
LJTI0_0:
	.long	LBB_0-LJTI0_0
	.long	LBB_1-LJTI0_0
	.long	LBB_2-LJTI0_0
	.long	LBB_default-LJTI0_0
	.end_data_region
.subsections_via_symbols
=== globals, pointers to them and the GOT
	.section	__TEXT,__text,regular,pure_instructions
	.globl	_get
	.p2align	4, 0x90
_get:
	movq	_counter@GOTPCREL(%rip), %rax
	movl	(%rax), %eax
	addl	_local_counter(%rip), %eax
	movq	_table+8(%rip), %rcx
	addl	(%rcx), %eax
	retq

	.globl	_set
	.p2align	4, 0x90
_set:
	movl	%edi, _local_counter(%rip)
	movq	_environ@GOTPCREL(%rip), %rax
	movq	(%rax), %rax
	retq

	.section	__DATA,__data
	.globl	_table
	.p2align	3
_table:
	.quad	_get
	.quad	_local_counter
	.quad	_set+4
	.quad	_external_thing

	.p2align	2
_local_counter:
	.long	7

	.comm	_counter, 4, 2
.subsections_via_symbols
=== zero-filled storage, in every spelling
	.text
	.globl	_bump
_bump:
	incq	_heap(%rip)
	incl	_small(%rip)
	movq	_big+16(%rip), %rax
	leaq	_scratch(%rip), %rcx
	retq

	.lcomm	_small, 4, 2
	.zerofill __DATA,__common,_big,64,5
	.zerofill __DATA,__bss,_heap,8,3
	.comm	_scratch, 256, 4
	.bss
_after:
	.space	3
	.globl	_after
=== symbols: visibility, weakness and entries
	.text
	.globl	_zeta, _alpha, _mid
	.private_extern _hidden
	.weak_definition _weak
	.globl	_weak
	.weak_reference _maybe
_alpha:
	callq	_zeta
	callq	_hidden
	callq	_weak
	callq	_maybe
	callq	_undefined_b
	callq	_undefined_a
	retq
_mid:
	nop
	.alt_entry _mid_inside
_mid_inside:
	retq
_hidden:
	retq
_weak:
	retq
_zeta:
	jmp	_alpha
	.no_dead_strip _keep
_keep:
	retq
_constant = 42
	.set	_flags, 0x10
	.globl	_flags
_alias = _alpha
_inside = _mid + 1
	.globl	_inside
=== literals, and which of them the relocations name
	.text
_f:
	movsd	LCPI0_0(%rip), %xmm0
	movss	LCPI0_1(%rip), %xmm1
	leaq	L_.str(%rip), %rdi
	leaq	L_.str.1(%rip), %rsi
	leaq	L_.str.1+3(%rip), %rdx
	cmpb	$0, L_.str.2(%rip)
	retq

	.section	__TEXT,__literal8,8byte_literals
	.p2align	3
LCPI0_0:
	.quad	0x400921fb54442d18

	.section	__TEXT,__literal4,4byte_literals
	.p2align	2
LCPI0_1:
	.long	0x3fc00000

	.section	__TEXT,__cstring,cstring_literals
L_.str:
	.asciz	"one"
L_.str.1:
	.asciz	"two"
L_.str.2:
	.asciz	"three"

	.section	__DATA,__data
_strings:
	.quad	L_.str
	.quad	L_.str.1
	.quad	L_.str.2+1
=== differences within and across atoms and sections
	.text
_a:
	nop
	jmp	_b
La_inner:
	nop
_b:
	ret
_c:
	ret
Lend:

	.const
_sizes:
	.long	_b - _a
	.long	La_inner - _a
	.long	Lend - _c
	.long	_c - _b
	.quad	_sizes - _a
	.long	Lconst_end - _sizes
Lconst_end:

	.data
_offsets:
	.long	_a - _offsets
	.long	_d - _offsets
	.quad	_b - _a
_d:
	.quad	0
	.long	_later - _d
	.long	_later - Lhere
Lhere:
_later:
	.long	0
=== branches that relax, within an atom and across
	.text
_f:
	jmp	L1
	je	L1
	jmp	_g
	jne	_g
	nop
L1:
	jmp	_f
	jb	L1
	.p2align	4, 0x90
_g:
	callq	L1
	jmp	_h
_h:
	jmp	_g
	ret
.subsections_via_symbols
=== sections of every kind
	.section	__TEXT,__text,regular,pure_instructions
_main:
	retq
	.section	__TEXT,__const
_c1:
	.quad	_main
	.section	__DATA,__const
_c2:
	.quad	_main
	.section	__DATA,__mod_init_func,mod_init_funcs
	.p2align	3
	.quad	_main
	.section	__DATA,__mod_term_func,mod_term_funcs
	.p2align	3
	.quad	_main
	.section	__TEXT,__text2,regular,pure_instructions
_other:
	callq	_main
	.section	__DATA,__nl_symbol_ptr,non_lazy_symbol_pointers
	.p2align	3
	.quad	0
	.section	__DATA,__thread_bss,thread_local_zerofill
	.space	8
	.section	__TEXT,__ustring
	.short	0x68, 0x69, 0
	.section	__DATA,__objc_data,regular,no_dead_strip
	.quad	_c1
	.data
	.quad	_c2
	.section	__TEXT,__text,regular,pure_instructions
	jmp	_other
=== padding in code, and a label at the end of a section
	.text
_f:
	nop
	.p2align	4, 0x90
_g:
	movl	$1, %eax
	.p2align	3, 0x90
	ret
_end:
	.data
	.quad	_end
	.byte	1
	.p2align	3
	.quad	_f
=== names that share a tail in the string table
	.globl	_a_b, _b, _xb
_a_b:
	ret
_b:
	ret
_xb:
	call	_zz_b
	call	_b_zz_b
